notes.title: Dashboard improvements
notes.body: Performance improvements to the home screen and better handling of large coaching practices. The onboarding checklist now displays faster and more reliably across all practice sizes.

notes.title: Two-step sign-in for staff
notes.body: Staff members can now enable two-factor authentication on their accounts. Navigate to Settings > Security to set up two-step verification via TOTP authenticators.

notes.title: Client invitations redesigned
notes.body: The client invitation flow is now simpler and faster. Bulk invitations are now supported from the People list.

notes.title: Stripe payment sync improvements
notes.body: Fixed an issue where payment disputes were not being synchronized to the local database immediately. The sync now completes within 30 seconds of Stripe processing the payment.
